summary.name: MusicBrainz Picard
summary.one_liner: Picard is a cross-platform music tagger, written in Python, that uses the MusicBrainz database and AcoustID fingerprints to identify and tag music files.
use_cases: Tagging and organizing a music library
Identifying untagged audio files by their sound
Looking up metadata for a music CD
Renaming music files using a custom naming script
summary.what_it_does: Picard is a music tagger powered by the community-maintained MusicBrainz database, which it uses to supply accurate information about millions of releases. It supports popular formats including MP3, FLAC, OGG, M4A, WMA and WAV. Using AcoustID audio fingerprints, it can identify files by their actual audio even when they have no metadata. It can look up an entire music CD with a click and find and download matching cover art. A scripting language lets users control how files are named and how tags are written, and plugins add extra features or can be written by the user.
notable: Identifies files by audio fingerprint (AcoustID) even without existing metadata
Scripting language for file naming and tag templates
caveats: Specific platforms beyond 'cross-platform' are not named on the page
